profile_model_flops: run get_flops_profile to compute the total FLOPs of a PyTorch model given input data
profile_model_flops_verbose: run get_flops_profile with verbose=True to print a detailed per-layer FLOPs profile
benchmark_model_complexity: build a script that uses get_flops_profile to benchmark the computational complexity of a model
compare_model_flops: create a comparison tool that calls get_flops_profile on multiple models and reports their FLOPs
review_get_flops_profile: review the get_flops_profile function to understand how FlopsProfiler is used for model profiling
